content:
#1 Riehl and Verity were by far not the first to introduce the concept of a weakly smothering functor. The concept has been reinveted/renamed a couple of times. Here are some references:

1) To my knowledge the first to study the concept in the context of categories of representations was Maurice Auslander in 1971 in his Queen Mary Lecture Notes "Representation dimension of Artin algebras"
2) The concept is called "epivalence" by Bernhard Keller in 1990 in "Chain complexes and stable categories"
3) Baues calls the concept "detecting functor", e.g. in 1995 in "Homotopy Types".
subject: Smothering functors - origin
